# RemoveColumnOptionRequest

- Namespace: `PPDS.Dataverse.Metadata.Authoring`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Dataverse`
- Kind: Class

## Summary

Request to remove an option from a column-scoped (local) option set (#1161).
Target the option by `PPDS.Dataverse.Metadata.Authoring.RemoveColumnOptionRequest.Value` or `PPDS.Dataverse.Metadata.Authoring.RemoveColumnOptionRequest.Label` (exactly one).
